agentUpdateInstructions: Update from 0.4.0 by merging v0.4.1 into the owner's checkout, preserving owner customizations, native passwords, current actor/project authority and explicit operator Send. 0.4.1 adds no migration and changes no contract clause or extension point; no data step is needed and the updated Worker can serve the existing store directly. A review prepared by 0.4.1 keeps its decisions and diagnostics as a private object under the import's storage prefix, with only the summary and that object's hash on the run row; reviews prepared by 0.4.0 keep them on the row and are read unchanged. Move in now splits a reviewed import into children of at most 10 source records (previously 20) and applies or reverses up to 20 journal rows per invocation (previously 10), which lowers Worker memory while a large import is applied or undone. Reviews, journals and imports created by 0.4.0 keep their recorded children and remain resumable and undoable unchanged; only reviews prepared after the update use the smaller children. Keep schema-2 manifests and raw payload sidecars intact and preserve private import originals with resumable journals. Preserve the accessibility checker HOLD, timed activation and portable-storage limits. An installation still on 0.3.0 or the 0.3 fix line follows the 0.4.0 instructions first (OPERATIONS.md, Upgrading from 0.3.x): back up, apply 0109_magic_signins.sql before the updated Worker if it is missing, then the ten additive migrations 0110_move_in.sql to 119_local_portability.sql in order before starting the updated Worker and before it serves traffic. Its magic_signins table and magic_signins_expiry index retain backup and restore obligations for expiry and consumption state; that migration does not rewrite existing rows, create accounts, send email or configure a provider. Email sign-in requires APP_ORIGIN, and password sign-in remains available. Never reset to upgrade.
publicReleaseNotes: HappyToHelp 0.4.1 is a fix release for 0.4.0. Applying or undoing a large Move in import uses less Worker memory: a reviewed import is split into children of at most 10 records, each invocation reverses or applies more of a child at once, and the D1 request meter no longer copies every bound value to measure it. Imports of up to 5,000 records reach review: preparing a review no longer reads the database once per child, a review's decision list is kept in private import storage instead of on the import's database row, and a background step that runs out of its query budget records the error on the import instead of leaving it in Preparing review. The delivery build now has time to finish its full verification. 0.4.1 adds no migration and reads every 0.4.0 store unchanged; a 0.4.0 installation merges v0.4.1 and serves its existing data, and a 0.3 installation follows the 0.4.0 upgrade steps in OPERATIONS.md. Known limits are unchanged from 0.4.0: accessibility is on a confirmed owner HOLD and no WCAG conformance is claimed; backups and archives cover D1 and R2 but not Durable Object storage, and full portable-storage fidelity is not established; hosted operating costs are unmeasured, and timed activation and paid-provider execution are not qualified; imports and connections are qualified with synthetic fixtures only, without real vendor exports or live Slack; no hosted installation, compliance or FedRAMP qualification is claimed. The hosted service at app.happytohelp.com is separate legacy production and is not part of this release.
